dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like the two of you are really close.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Of course! I mean, we grew up side-by-side. But now, he's already this Lightkeeper big shot, and I... am nowhere close.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, he's always been incredibly thoughtful and responsible, even when we were kids. He's a fantastic person, plain and simple — the kind of guy you can't even bring yourself to envy.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: *Sigh* If only I were a bit stronger, a bit more capable, he might not have had it so tough... You know, he hasn't come back even once this whole time.
